The current case has been with us for one week, and at present, there is no error — the charger is operating normally.
Regarding the similar issue observed with another charger, we identified a fault with the power converter and have already escalated that case to the regional team for on-site intervention.
Should the issue occur again at this location, we kindly request that you create a new case. We will then involve our experts to further investigate and resolve the matter.
We hope you are satisfied with this response. Please let us know if we can proceed with case closure.
